commands.description: Control per-thread cloud sync without sending a prompt to the model.
commands.usage: /cloud status | on | off | sync | pull [session-id] | map | unmap | mappings | takeover --confirm | detach | remove --confirm --retain-attachments | export | repair [--confirm-mapping]
commands.setupNeeded: Cloud setup is required. Status, local detach, local opt-out, and export remain available offline.

ui.gitWarning: Conversation data sync does not transfer project files. This inspection/advice is read-only; only an explicitly confirmed New worktree import provisions a fresh checkout. Verify the correct local files and commit before using tools. The commands below never fetch, push, switch or allocate worktrees; they only inspect refs. Git facts never grant writer permission.
ui.gitConservative: Dirty is a bounded raw-content comparison, not Git status: ignored/untracked files may conservatively count as dirty. Filters, attributes, CRLF normalization, partial/sparse repositories or inspection limits produce Unknown. Source facts describe the last published snapshot, not current ownership.
ui.gitUnavailable: Git facts unavailable or this folder is not a verified local repository.
ui.title: Azure Cloud Sync
ui.failed: The cloud operation failed. Refresh status before retrying.
ui.invalid: Check the required fields and try again.
ui.enabled: Enable cloud sync for this thread
ui.onWarning: Conversation logs can contain secrets. Enable upload only to an account whose writers you trust; cloud writers can rewrite history.
ui.takeoverWarning: Tools already running on the previous device may finish. Stop all other writers and ensure that device is idle before taking over.
ui.detachWarning: Continue locally without changing the retained cloud copy. Divergent histories are never merged automatically.
ui.removeWarning: Remove this cloud conversation. If this is a root, its descendants are also removed. Local history is not deleted. Shared attachments are retained.
ui.retainAck: I understand shared attachments are retained and a root removal includes its descendants.
ui.resurrectWarning: Create a new cloud generation from this local history. The removed generation is not restored and old writers cannot continue it.
ui.mappingRepairWarning: Stop and verify the complete forward-localized prefix before confirming repair. Historical local paths are never rewritten.
ui.liveWarning: Restart the Host to catch up this retained live thread. Closing the browser view is NOT disposal of the Host runtime.
ui.folderWarning: Choose a real Host folder mapping, then explicitly confirm and repair. No folder is guessed.
ui.unstableWarning: The mapping changed or is unstable. Sync is stopped until you verify and explicitly reconfirm repair.
ui.presetWarning: The required preset is unavailable. Restore it on the Host, then retry; no partial model resume is allowed.
ui.modelWarning: The required model is unavailable. Configure it on the Host, then retry; no partial model resume is allowed.
ui.incompleteWarning: Import is incomplete or unverified. Sending remains paused. Repair the retained snapshot first, even when cloud sync is off; opting out does not make partial history safe to resume.
ui.detachIncompleteWarning: Keep cloud sync off without changing the retained cloud copy. The local import is incomplete: detaching does not make it safe to resume. Repair the retained snapshot before continuing locally. Divergent histories are never merged automatically.
ui.conflictWarning: Histories differ. Keep local, export a local snapshot, or remove from cloud. Merge and overwrite are not supported.
ui.degradedWarning: Some attachments were not recovered. Review the verified imported history before explicitly acknowledging the missing attachments.
ui.foreignBlock: Another plugin's composer block is left unchanged.
ui.secretHelp: A blank field keeps the existing credential. It is sent only by RPC and cleared after submission, cancellation or leaving this form. Connection strings determine their own endpoint; account metadata is not proof of that target.
ui.readOnlyCredential: This credential is read-only or unavailable. Change it at its reported source; non-secret authentication settings remain editable.
ui.authPending: Authentication update is pending. Sync remains stopped. Re-enter or clear the credential, or explicitly select CLI / managed identity to recover.
ui.uncertain: Credential persistence is uncertain. Explicitly replace or clear it before reuse.
ui.defaultOff: New threads always start with cloud sync OFF (locked)
ui.mappingWarning: Adding, editing or removing a mapping stops affected threads. Reconfirm and repair explicitly afterward. Historical local paths are never rewritten.
ui.mappingConfirm: Apply mapping change and stop affected threads
ui.mappingRemoveConfirm: Remove this mapping and stop affected threads
ui.import.title: Import cloud thread
ui.import.customFolder: Choose an existing folder or enter a custom path
ui.import.chooseProject: Choose a registered source project folder
ui.import.actorHelp: This existing thread only authorizes Git operations using its current native permissions. It is not copied or attached to the imported worktree. No message is sent and no helper thread is created.
ui.import.actorUnavailable: The selected local permission context cannot inspect this repository. Check its existing native permission controls and refresh; permissions are never elevated automatically.
ui.import.label: Optional worktree label
ui.import.localMappingRoot: Optional Local mapping root (existing ancestor folder)
ui.import.geometryHelp: The localized original folder must exactly match the selected native folder. A broader mapping root does not assign a parent project folder. Every historical working-directory change must stay within the verified mapping.
ui.import.hintsUnproven: A branch hint is not proof that it contains the commit or that the commit was pushed. The Host verifies the selected local object. Missing code must be prepared/fetched separately; import does not fetch automatically.
ui.import.sameIdentity: Keep the original cloud thread ID:
ui.import.codeNotice: Import restores committed conversation history and supported attachments, not project files, unpublished conversation events or uncommitted source-machine changes. New worktree creates a fresh managed checkout at the confirmed local commit; Local never switches branches or overwrites files.
ui.import.codeAck: I understand the selected local code differs from, or cannot be verified against, the source snapshot. Continue with this explicit code choice.
ui.import.uploadWarning: This explicitly opts this local copy into cloud continuation. Conversation history and attachments may contain secrets. No prompt or model execution is started by import.
ui.import.localObservedHelp: This is a bounded read-only observation, not a branch switch or code restoration. Unknown, dirty or different code requires the separate acknowledgment; a branch name alone is not code proof.
ui.import.reason.source-code-unverified: The source code snapshot is unavailable or not verified against this history. Prepare the intended code or separately acknowledge that it is unverified.
ui.import.reason.source-working-tree-dirty: The source has uncommitted changes. They are not restored by importing its committed snapshot; separate code acknowledgment is required.
ui.import.reason.source-working-tree-unknow: The source working-file state is unknown. Import does not prove those files were restored; separate code acknowledgment is required.
ui.import.reason.local-code-unverified: The receiving folder is non-Git or its code could not be verified within the selected scope. Separate code acknowledgment is required.
ui.import.reason.local-working-tree-clean: The receiving working tree was observed clean. Its exact HEAD is compared separately with the source snapshot.
ui.import.reason.local-working-tree-dirty: The receiving folder has local changes. Import does not alter or restore them; separate code acknowledgment is required.
ui.import.reason.local-working-tree-unknown: The receiving working-file state could not be verified. Separate code acknowledgment is required.
ui.import.reason.local-code-snapshot-mismat: The receiving HEAD or object format differs from the verified source snapshot. Prepare the intended checkout or separately acknowledge the difference.
ui.import.reason.local-branch-hint-differs: The receiving branch label or detached state differs from the source. Names are display hints, not proof of matching code; check the separate commit and working-file comparison. Import will not switch the branch.
ui.import.reason.code-review-required: The recorded code review is missing or no longer valid. History remains read-only; execution stays blocked until an explicit supported code review/recovery is completed. Do not bypass the import guard.
ui.import.continueWarning: Continue is a separate execution action. The Host must verify current local readiness and fresh cloud ownership/catch-up. It does not force takeover from another device. Native background promotion errors while waiting for Continue do not mean the copied history is corrupt.
ui.import.pendingAck: I reviewed the restored pending input and explicitly allow it to run after the safety checks.
ui.import.closeHelp: Closing this view never deletes checkout files. Reopen Import for the same cloud thread to inspect/resume the recorded operation; no replacement checkout or thread ID is allocated.
ui.import.requestFailed: The import request could not complete. Refresh this operation before retrying. No alternate destination or local execution fallback was selected.
ui.import.unavailable: Destination import is unavailable in this composition. Check the required profile safety setup.
ui.import.generationChanged: The cloud generation changed. Refresh the catalog; this view cannot adopt a different generation.
ui.import.genericReason: The operation needs explicit inspection or recovery. No model execution or replacement destination was authorized.
ui.import.reason.profile-required: Enable the persistent import-safety profile configuration first. Its required provider and Session/Agent dependency gates prevent unsafe older-version fallback. Existing legacy cloud sync remains separate.
ui.import.reason.worktree-unavailable: A compatible managed-worktree import capability is unavailable. Do not silently substitute a Local destination.
ui.import.reason.unsupported-platform: This destination import requires a verified local durability/claim primitive. The current platform is not enabled.
ui.import.reason.seeded-unsupported: This seeded/forked history is not enabled for the current proven initial-materialization path. No destination effects were started.
ui.import.reason.unsupported-thread: Independent destination placement supports ordinary threads only, not subagent threads. The original lineage is not rewritten.
ui.import.reason.generation-changed: The source generation changed. Refresh and review a new target; no history was replaced.
ui.import.reason.source-disabled: The source cloud thread is disabled. New import cannot silently re-enable it.
ui.import.reason.source-removed: The source cloud thread was removed. No replacement generation was adopted.
ui.import.reason.no-cwd: The source has no supported original working directory.
ui.import.reason.unsupported-header: The source header cannot be proven to reopen with identical logical metadata on this backend.
ui.import.reason.schedule-unsafe: Scheduled histories are not supported by this import flow.
ui.import.reason.preset-missing: Install the required preset on this Host before importing.
ui.import.reason.model-unavailable: The source model is unavailable on this Host. Select a usable model before execution.
ui.import.reason.needs-folder: Choose a real existing Host folder. No path is guessed or created for Local mode.
ui.import.reason.mapping-unstable: The source mapping no longer resolves to the reviewed exact destination.
ui.import.reason.code-mismatch: The selected code snapshot differs from the observed source snapshot and requires explicit acknowledgment.
ui.import.reason.dirty-source: Source uncommitted/untracked changes are not transferred. The selected commit does not restore them.
ui.import.reason.git-unavailable: Git context is absent, legacy or unavailable. Choose and verify local code explicitly.
ui.import.reason.metadata-stale: The stored Git observation cannot seed a fresh verified snapshot suggestion.
ui.import.reason.paused-other-device: Another device may still own this cloud thread. Import/Open does not force takeover.
ui.import.reason.ownership-unverified: Fresh cloud ownership has not been proven. History can be read, but execution remains blocked.
ui.import.reason.pending-input: Restored pending input requires separate explicit confirmation before execution.
ui.import.reason.continue-required: History is ready. Explicit Continue and its safety checks are still required before a native writer resumes.
ui.import.reason.binding-incomplete: History may be present, but required native/project/worktree binding has not completed. Do not treat this as a successful alternate Local import.
ui.import.reason.cancelled: Import was cancelled. Already committed checkout/history effects are retained; no files were automatically removed.
ui.import.reason.recovery-required: The recorded operation needs recovery. Unknown effects or dead/uncertain process claims are not automatically stolen or recreated.
ui.import.reason.busy: Another operation owns this thread or repository. Inspect the recorded operation instead of allocating a duplicate.
ui.import.reason.expired-review: This review expired. Refresh and explicitly review the destination again.
ui.remoteHelp: Listing does not load a conversation runtime. Import exactly one selected thread explicitly; no automatic bulk import or model resume.
ui.projectionDegradedWarning: The complete verified history is present, but its native projection cache could not be fully warmed. Acknowledge this limitation to continue locally; native list metadata may be incomplete. This does not re-enable cloud sync.
ui.emptyRemote: No cloud conversations in this page.
ui.importWarning: Cold-import this one selected thread after checking its source folder mapping. Import does not send a prompt or resume a model. Open it only after import succeeds.
ui.advisory: Device and lease fields are advisory metadata, not proof of ownership.
ui.noSelection: Select a native conversation to manage its cloud state. Global settings remain available.
ui.trust: Use a private trusted storage account. Conversation logs and attachments may contain secrets; storage writers can rewrite history.

disclosures.upload: Conversation logs can contain secrets. Enable upload only to an account whose writers you trust.
disclosures.takeover: Tools already running on the previous device may finish. Ensure that device is idle before taking over.
disclosures.remove: Remove the cloud conversation and its descendants. Shared attachments are retained; local history is not deleted.
disclosures.detach: Continue locally without changing the retained cloud copy. Divergent histories are never merged automatically.
disclosures.mapping: Editing a mapping stops affected threads. Confirm and repair only when the complete forward-localized prefix still matches; historical local paths are never rewritten.
disclosures.live: Restart the host to catch up a retained live thread. Closing its browser view does not dispose the host Agent.
